command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
since=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "round" && $4 !~ /^implement#/ { print $1; exit }')
start=$(git log --format='%H %s' | awk '$2 == "gnomish:" && $3 == "task" && $4 == "started" { print $1; exit }')
[ -n "$since" ] || since=$(git rev-parse "$start^" 2>/dev/null || git merge-base HEAD origin/main)
changed=$({ git diff --name-only "$since"; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard; } | sort -u | grep -v '^\.gnomish-task/' || true)
forbidden=$(printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep -E '^(openspec/|temporary-docs/|\.gnomish/|\.github/|\.claude/|docs/adr/|CLAUDE\.md$)' | grep -vxF "$change/tasks.md" | grep -v "^$reports/handoff/" || true)
[ -z "$forbidden" ] || { echo "$forbidden"; echo "the implement stage edits only packages/, docs/ outside docs/adr/, the checkboxes of $change/tasks.md and $reports/handoff/ - put changes to these paths into a handoff patch (see .gnomish/stages/specify/handoff.md) and restore the files above with: git checkout $since -- <file>"; exit 1; }
dependencies=$(printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep -E '(^|/)(package\.json|pnpm-lock\.yaml)$' || true)
if [ -n "$dependencies" ] && ! grep -qiE 'pnpm add|dependenc|package\.json' "$change/tasks.md"; then echo "$dependencies"; echo "tasks.md asks for no dependency or package.json change - restore the files above with: git checkout $since -- <file>"; exit 1; fi

command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
for patch in "$reports"/handoff/*.patch; do
  [ -e "$patch" ] || continue
  git apply --check "$patch" || { echo "$patch does not apply to the branch - regenerate it as .gnomish/stages/specify/handoff.md describes"; exit 1; }
done
if grep -qE '^- H[0-9]+' "$change/tasks.md" && [ ! -f "$reports/handoff/README.md" ]; then
  echo "tasks.md lists handoff items under Human follow-up but $reports/handoff/README.md is missing"; exit 1
fi

findings.message: Module boundary violation: packages/client/src/test/features/grid_view/steps/grid_view_meeting_handle_reach_unit.steps.tsx:9 has `import { getMeetingHandleRow } from "@/views/grid/meetingHandleRow";`, reaching into an internal file of the views/grid module (which has no index.ts). CLAUDE.md says "Imports only through `index.ts` of a module, never from sibling internals" and process-invariants.md says "Import only through `index.ts` of a module. Never import from internal files of a sibling module." It is the only file in src that imports `@/views/grid/<internal>`. Fix: add a views/grid/index.ts that exports getMeetingHandleRow (and MeetingHandleCandidateRows) and import from "@/views/grid", or drive the 'Handle rows among the visible rows' scenario through the rendered Grid instead.

Missing traceability: packages/client/src/model/locationCommands.ts gains `MEETING_START_EQUALS_END` and `MEETING_END_BEFORE_START` (lines 41-42, task 2.3 / D2), but its header JSDoc has no reference to this change. tasks.md says "every new or touched production file gets a JSDoc line `Implements <ids> of refine-meeting-range-entry-and-handles (D<n>).`". Add `Implements FR2 of refine-meeting-range-entry-and-handles (D2): MEETING_START_EQUALS_END, MEETING_END_BEFORE_START.`

Stale doc comment: the JSDoc of useMeetingHandleDrag (packages/client/src/views/grid/useMeetingHandleDrag.ts:33-36) still says "The minutes come from the pointer's position over the hour strip", but after D7 applyPointer sends `pressMinutes + (travelPx / cellPitchPx) * MINUTES_PER_HOUR`, i.e. the handle's minutes at the press plus the pointer's travel since the press. Update the comment to describe the press-relative rule so it matches the code and the modified 'Drag a meeting handle' requirement.
